problem.chooseImage.note: the image library's upload: no file was sent

problem.interrupted: The upload was interrupted. Try again.

problem.tooLarge.message: The image is {size} MB; the limit is 5 MB. Email images work best under 200 KB.
problem.tooLarge.note: size: the image's size in megabytes with one decimal, 6.2

problem.uploadTooLarge.message: The file is {size} MB; the limit is 20 MB. Export the image smaller and retry.
problem.uploadTooLarge.note: uploads are resized and compressed before they're stored; size: the file's size in megabytes with one decimal, 23.4

problem.gifTooLarge.message: The GIF is {size} MB; GIFs can be up to 5 MB because they're stored as uploaded, so animations keep their frames.
problem.gifTooLarge.note: size: the GIF's size in megabytes with one decimal, 6.2

problem.stillTooLarge.message: Even resized and compressed, the image is {size} MB; the limit is 5 MB. Use a smaller image.
problem.stillTooLarge.note: size: the stored image's size in megabytes with one decimal, 5.4

problem.webp: WebP images don't display in Outlook and several other email clients. Upload a PNG, JPEG or GIF.
problem.svg: SVG images don't display in Gmail or Outlook. Upload a PNG, JPEG or GIF.
problem.notImage: That file isn't an image ReputeCast can use. Upload a PNG, JPEG or GIF.
problem.damaged: The image is damaged or incomplete and couldn't be read. Export it again and retry.

problem.dimensions.message: The image dimensions are invalid or too large (50 megapixels at most).
problem.dimensions.note: a phone's full-resolution photo is about 48 megapixels

problem.notFound.note: removing an image from the library that is no longer there
